# @coldmind/http-routes

> HTTP route contracts in the shape of rpc contracts: declare method, path and schemas; a route table matches requests with a fixed precedence; a route group converts to the rpc contract a server registers. No I/O. Depends on @coldmind/rpc and @coldmind/model only.

## Import

- `import { httpContract, RouteTable, describeRoutes, procContractOf, coerceFields, compilePath, matchPath } from "@coldmind/http-routes"`
- Decorators: `import { httpController, get, post, put, patch, del, httpRoute, routesOf, routeHandlersOf } from "@coldmind/http-routes"`
- Serving and answering is a different package: `@coldmind/net.adapter.http` (`httpBusAdapter`, `respond`).

## Invariants

- The route table, not the bus, decides which route a request is for. Precedence among routes matching one path: literal segment over `:param` over `*wildcard`, compared left to right. `HEAD` falls back to `GET`.
- Never put user input in a topic. A route's topic is fixed: `http/<group>/<route>`; its proc is `http.<group>.<route>`. Path parameters travel in the payload.
- Group and route names match `[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*` (topic-safe) or `httpContract` throws.
- `params` keys must equal the `:name` / `*name` parameters of `path` exactly. `GET` has no `body`. `chunk` needs `stream`. `status` is an integer 200 to 599. Two routes with the same method and path shape throw.
- Without a `params` schema, params are strings keyed by the path parameter names.
- `access` defaults to `"authenticated"`; values: `"public"`, `"authenticated"`, `{ roles: [...] }`.
- Route procs carry `{ params, query?, headers?, body? }` as args and no `result`: the ingress validates the reply body against the route's `result`.
- Paths are matched percent-encoded and each segment is decoded alone, so an encoded `/` stays inside its segment; a malformed escape is `bad-path` (400).

## Match results

`new RouteTable([groups]).match(method, rawPath)` returns one of:
- `{ kind: "match", route, params, viaHead }`
- `{ kind: "method-not-allowed", allow }` (405 with `Allow`)
- `{ kind: "not-found" }` (404)
- `{ kind: "bad-path" }` (400)

## Machine-readable contract

`describeRoutes(group)` returns JSON: `{ name, doc, order: string[], routes: { [name]: { name, method, path, topic, doc, access, status, idempotent, noTimeout, stream?, params?, query?, headers?, body?, result?, chunk? } } }`. Schema slots hold `SchemaInfo` from @coldmind/rpc and are present only when declared.

## Canonical examples

Route contract:
```ts
import { num, str } from "@coldmind/model";
import { httpContract, RouteTable } from "@coldmind/http-routes";

const orders = httpContract("orders", {
  list: { method: "GET", path: "/orders", query: { limit: num().default(10) }, access: "public" },
  get: { method: "GET", path: "/orders/:id", params: { id: str() }, result: { id: str(), sku: str() }, access: "public" },
  create: { method: "POST", path: "/orders", body: { sku: str().min(2) }, status: 201 },
});
new RouteTable([orders]).match("GET", "/orders/42"); // { kind: "match", params: { id: "42" }, route: { topic: "http/orders/get", proc: "http.orders.get" } }
```

Class style:
```ts
import { httpController, get, post, routesOf } from "@coldmind/http-routes";

@httpController("orders")
class Orders {
  @get("/orders/:id", { access: "public" })
  get({ args }) { return { id: args.params.id }; }
  @post("/orders", { body: { sku: str() }, status: 201 })
  create({ args }) { return args.body; }
}
const group = routesOf(Orders); // answer with respondWith(bus, new Orders()) from @coldmind/net.adapter.http
```

Runtime wiring (with the adapter package):
```ts
const runtime = new BunRuntime({ webserver: { port: 8080, http: { routes: [orders] } } });
const app = await new App().use(runtime).start();
respond(app.bus, orders, { list: ({ args }) => ({ limit: args.query.limit }), get: ({ args }) => ({ id: args.params.id, sku: "A1" }), create: ({ args }) => args.body });
```

## Common mistakes

- Declaring `params: { id: str() }` for a path without `:id` (or the reverse): throws at `httpContract`.
- Giving a `GET` route a `body`: throws. Use `query`.
- Expecting `/orders/latest` and `/orders/:id` to conflict: they do not, the literal wins.
- Putting a request value into a topic or proc name by hand: the topic is derived from the group and route name only.
- Registering `http/` topics for remote peers: `http/` is reserved by the network bus controller.
- Forgetting `respond(...)`: a route nobody answers is a 503.

## Exports

<!-- exports:start -->
- `function assertTopicSafe(kind: string, name: string): void`: Throws unless `name` is safe to put in a bus topic segment.
- `type BoundRouteHandlers = Record<string, (input: any, call: any) => unknown>; `: Handlers as the responder registration takes them: one function per route, bound to the instance.
- `function coerceFields(schema: Shape | AnyModel, raw: RawFields): Record<string, unknown>`: Coerces raw string values by the kind of the field that will receive them: `number` from a numeric string, `boolean` from `true`/`false`/`1`/`0`, `list` from one or several values (items coerced by the item kind).
- `function compareSpecificity(a: CompiledPath, b: CompiledPath): number`: Orders two patterns that both match a path: negative when `a` is more specific.
- `type CompiledPath = { … }`: A path pattern ready for matching.
- `type CompiledRoute = { … }`: A route with everything the ingress needs to dispatch it.
- `function compilePath(path: string): CompiledPath`: Compiles a route path.
- `const del`: `@httpRoute` for `DELETE` (`delete` is a reserved word).
- `function describeRoutes(c: HttpContract): RouteContractInfo`: Describes a route group as JSON-serializable data.
- `function fieldNamesOf(s: FieldsSchema): string[]`: The field names of a params, query or headers schema.
- `type FieldsSchema = Shape | AnyModel; `: A shape or model of fields; each value arrives from the URL or a header as a string and is coerced by field kind.
- `const get`: `@httpRoute` for `GET`.
- `const HTTP_METHODS: readonly HttpMethod[]`: The methods a route may declare, in a fixed order.
- `function httpContract<R extends RouteMap>(name: string, routes: R, opts: HttpContractOptions = {}): HttpContract<R>`: Declares a group of routes, validating every definition: path syntax, `params` keys equal to the path parameters, no body on `GET`, a valid `status`, `chunk` only with `stream`, and topic-safe names.
- `type HttpContract<R extends RouteMap = RouteMap> = { … }`: A named group of routes.
- `type HttpContractOptions = { doc?: string | undefined }; `: Options of {@link httpContract}.
- `const httpController`: Marks a class as the route group `name`.
- `type HttpMethod = "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "PATCH" | "DELETE"; `: Methods a route can be declared with.
- `const httpRoute`: Declares a method as a route of its class's group.
- `type HttpRouteDef = { … }`: One route.
- `class InvalidPathError extends Error`: The request path was not valid percent-encoding.
- `function matchPath(compiled: CompiledPath, rawPath: string): Record<string, string> | null`: Matches a request path against a compiled path.
- `const patch`: `@httpRoute` for `PATCH`.
- `type PathSegment = | { readonly kind: "literal"; readonly value: string } | { readonly kind: "param"; readonly name: string } | { readonly kind: "wildcard"; readonly name: string }; `: One piece of a compiled path.
- `const post`: `@httpRoute` for `POST`.
- `function procContractOf(c: HttpContract): Contract`: The rpc contract a route group is registered as: controller `http.<name>`, one proc per route whose `args` are `{ params, query?, headers?, body? }`.
- `const put`: `@httpRoute` for `PUT`.
- `type RawFields = Record<string, string | readonly string[]>; `: Raw strings from a URL or headers: one value, or several for a repeated name.
- `type RouteArgs<D extends HttpRouteDef> = { params: D extends { params: infer S extends Schema } ? OutputOf<S> : Record<string, string>; } & (D extends { query: infer S extends Schema } ? { query: OutputOf<S> } : unknown) &`: The values a handler receives for route `D`: validated and defaulted.
- `type RouteContractInfo = { … }`: A route group as data: its name, doc, and every route by name in declaration order.
- `function routeHandlersOf(instance: object): BoundRouteHandlers`: The handlers for an instance of a decorated class: each route method bound to `instance`.
- `type RouteInfo = { … }`: One route as data.
- `type RouteMap = Record<string, HttpRouteDef>; `: Route definitions by route name.
- `type RouteMatch = | { readonly kind: "match"; readonly route: CompiledRoute; readonly params: Record<string, string>; readonly viaHead: boolean } | { readonly kind: "method-not-allowed"; readonly allow: readonly string[] } | { readonly kind: "not-found" } | { readonly kind: "bad-path" }; `: What {@link RouteTable.match} found.
- `function routesOf(ctor: Function): HttpContract`: The route group a decorated class declares.
- `type RouteStream = "chunked" | "sse"; `: How a route sends its result: `chunk`s as a chunked body, or as server-sent events.
- `class RouteTable`: Routes of one or more contracts.
<!-- exports:end -->

## Test

- `bun run --filter @coldmind/http-routes test` (also `bun test tests/http` from the framework root)
- `bun packages/contract/http-routes/examples/routes.demo.ts`
